title: OpenAI Codex evolves into desktop super-app with computer use
summary: OpenAI's Codex app now provides macOS computer use (visual UI control with its own cursor for front-end iteration and apps without APIs), in-app image generation via GPT Image 1.5, and cross-session task continuation. A research preview called Chronicle gives Codex persistent memory of day-to-day work. Currently Mac-only for Pro users.
